title: Vantage Cloud Pricing Price
description: A Price entry representing the cost of a cloud Product in a specific region and unit.

id.description: The unique identifier for the Price.

unit.description: The pricing unit (e.g., per hour, per GB-month).

region.description: The cloud region this price applies to.

description.description: A description of the pricing tier or option.

product_id.description: The identifier of the associated Product.
